text: Lost in the countryside on the way home from a Kiev seminary, the student Khoma Brutus is ridden through the night sky by an old woman he beats until she becomes a beautiful girl. Soon he is summoned to pray over a wealthy sotnik's dead daughter and realises she is the witch. Locked in a candlelit chapel for three nights, he [draws a sacred chalk circle|rules|faith and charms protect] as [she climbs from her coffin|threat|the dead that rise] calling his name, and on the last night she [summons Viy|origin|deliberately called up].
